matches.note: Wrestling under the ring name "The Luv Machine." After the bell, a newcomer billed as "Rampage" attacked both wrestlers with his own finisher.
Both men brawled outside the ring past the referee's ten count and were ruled a double count-out.

matches.how: pinfall, using a wooden stick brought to ringside by Paul Valentine

matches.note: The federation's president named the winner the number-one contender for the newly created EWA Intercontinental Championship, against an opponent he announced would be "Crippler" Evan Crowley.
During the match, Evan Crowley struck Damien Black's valet Danielle from ringside; Black finished Valentine after the interference before attending to her.
